french_source_text: A{S^{-1}} est plat sur chacun des anneaux A_{f}
english_prior_text: A{S^{-1}} is flat for each of the rings A_{f}
required_english_text: A{S^{-1}} is flat over each of the rings A_{f}
rationale: In module theory, French plat sur un anneau is flat over a ring. The inherited English preposition for is nonstandard technical usage; over restores the canonical mathematical relation without changing the proposition.

french_source_text: On voit donc que A_{S} est un anneau local d'idéal maximal m
english_prior_text: We thus see that A_{S} a local ring with maximal ideal m
required_english_text: We thus see that A_{S} is a local ring with maximal ideal m
rationale: The French explicitly has est. The inherited English omitted the finite copula and produced an ungrammatical sentence. Restoring is exactly preserves the source assertion that A_{S} is local.

french_source_text: On sait déjà (7.6.11, (ii)) que A{S^{-1}} est noethérien
english_prior_text: We know from before (7.6.11(ii)) that A{S^{-1}} is Noetherian
required_english_text: We already know from (7.6.11(ii)) that A{S^{-1}} is Noetherian
rationale: French on sait déjà is idiomatically and precisely we already know. The inherited phrase we know from before is nonidiomatic English. The normalization changes no mathematical content and is logged because it departs from the inherited wording.
